notes.title: Never Surrender!
notes.content:
It's time for a price drop!

As a solo indie developer the most important thing right now is getting feedback on the game and giving players a chance to enjoy everything the game has to offer. We want to keep developing the game adding more content, challenges, enemies, events and everything that makes Earth: 9000 so fun and challenging to play.

The best way to do that is right now is to drop our price to a more reasonable position. What's the point in making games if your not priced attractive enough for people to give it a shot? Well, that's an easy fix. 

In addition to our price drop we're also dropping in some new dimensional space backdrops, giving us even more pretty images and more visual madness.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38087737/715f52894433134be9b4faaf7f070717a8a3dd27.png[/img]

You can read more about the drop on our blog post over here.
[url=https://www.gamasutra.com/blogs/StevenCaywood/20201002/371291/Indie_Fear_Failure_or_Freakout.php]Gamasutra Blog[/url]

Stay tuned for a new update soon!

notes.title: Earth: 9000 - Go for Launch!
notes.content:
[b]Earth: 9000 is leaving Early Access immediately. We are go for launch![/b]

[b]Available now at a 20% off launch discount.[/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38087737/79ea67be88f72119a57bbed528856f761414c6d4.png[/img]

[b][h1]Early Access Improvements[/h1][/b]
Here's just some of the changes that Earth: 9000 has seen over its time in Early Access

[list]
[*] Art Overhaul
[*] New Alien Ships
[*] Unexpected Events
[*] New Ship Art
[*] Time Compression
[*] Wave Skipping
[*] New Pickups
[*] Achievements
[*] Steam Leaderboards
[*] And more quality of life than you can shake a planet at
[/list]

[b][h1]Newly Added[/h1][/b]
Painted Backgrounds
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38087737/7bc2a73e4ebdf64075d3944891884809e3eb49d3.png[/img]

Tip Screens
Enemy Info Alerts
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38087737/974c1fbe86cdbf8897c76ba2eb8b83ebb436a9f3.png[/img]

[b][h1]It's not over yet...[/h1][/b]
Just because we've left early access, doesn't mean the ride is over. We've got a new update scheduled for next week that will add a couple more ship types and the swarm unexpected event. After that; easy and serious difficulty modes, weapon challenges and ship challenges. Updates right through the end of the year, and maybe some console action? Yes, please!

notes.title: Earth: 9000 - Achievement Unlocked!
notes.content:
Achievements! 23 achievements have been added, one of the last major remaining features. Although some achievements are simple that are unlocked for playing and progressing others require some specific effort.

In addition to achievements, Steam Leaderboards are now tracking kills and best waves. This is creating a little healthy competition for the community. We'll be looking at seasonal competitive stats to be reset on a monthly basis. Perhaps we can get some rewards for the winners.

Some weapons have undergone improvements like Seeker Burst yielding more warheads firing over a longer period time and increased damage for Q-Carbon Driver.

And finally the medium sized ships are now pathing and tracking a bit better and won't feel like they're constantly trying to escape off screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38087737/1843c9b55695c400c15e742321593e9acaf234ef.png[/img]

Early Access will be coming to a close very soon with these major features out of the way, and we're looking forward to adding even more as we are fully released.

notes.title: Earth: 9000 - Fresh Metal
notes.content:
The Alien menace has unleashed their newest devastating ships to turn the tide against Earth.

The Missile Boat moves slowly and fires erratically, unfortunately it's ordinance are devastating seeking warheads. Their erratic launch vectors mean they approach the Earth at odd angles complicating their destruction and defense. 

The Drone Carrier sprints around the Earth firing rapidly in all directions, that in itself isn't unusual trouble, but when destroyed, they release a batch of drones that clog up the battlefield, distract your seeking warheads and generally become a significant hazard.

The Cruise Missile is now your adversary in the Fighter Assault, rebranded to Missile Assault. They approach Earth in huge numbers and devastating damage if they reach their target.

Last but not least, the Heavy Fighter enters the fray firing rapidly and moving just as quickly itself. Where normal fighters go down in just a few hits, the Heavy Fighter takes much more damage to bring down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38087737/7d74b53be5d84648ba1a34a0623a43efbb9f8065.png[/img]


Moving towards Achievements, Clouds save and nearing the end of Early Access. Hype!

notes.title: Earth: 9000 - Weapons Hot!
notes.content:
The Weapons Hot update add a variety of new balance changes and some quality of life fixes we've had our eye on for some time now. Although some of these changes may make the initial waves easier, it just means you get to the real meat grinder that much sooner.

The key changes are allowing all Kinetic weapons to have zero ammo cost. They've been balanced to account for that and their other properties, like shots speeds, fire rates, destroying enemy projectiles or piercing enemy ships keeps them balanced amongst each other.

The other major change is the inclusion of 3 new pickups that can spawn when enemies are destroyed. The Health Cannister, keeping you in the fight longer. The Research Cannister providing you with more upgrade potential. The Hazardous Cannister, you don't want this, the hazardous chemicals deal serious damage to the Earth.

[b]Notable Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Kinetic Weapons are now free to use, no ammo cost
[*] Events now reward full ammo and shields
[*] Health, Research and Hazardous Cannisters added
[*] Upgrade Selection Improvements
[*] Removed small shield and ammo cannisters
[*] Ships are more easily disabled with Ion Cannon shots
[*] Death screen updated to randomly choose its strange new earth dimension
[*] Sound concurrency adjustments for Nukes, they're noisy
[*] Improved ship movement for medium sized ships
[*] Intro cin skipping, it's amazing but you don't need to see it every time
[/list]

[url=https://imgur.com/HfoLJT6][img]https://i.imgur.com/HfoLJT6.png?1[/img][/url]

Next update is coming along nicely and should provide some new ship types for the your defensive pleasures.

notes.title: Earth: 9000 - Lights, Camera, Explosions!
notes.content:
Gameplay has never been an issue. Dynamic, deep and difficult with a familiarity that makes it click when you play. 

However, if it's not pretty enough to look at, who wants to dive in and find all that great gameplay. Well, finally we've updated the art of nearly everything in the game.

The Alien Ships look like spaceships, instead of minimalist outlines. Enemy and player projectiles now fit with the rest of the style. Debris clouds and explosions have been improved to an incredible degree and the lighting..the lighting adds an entire new level of intensity to the action. 

Earth: 9000 is a visual bombardment, mechanically dynamic, very hard, and really fun. Now it looks as good as the gameplay gives.

Check out the updated trailer!
[previewyoutube=KOnUHXKiFnw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Earth: 9000 - Early Access - Wave 1 Updates Complete!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Earth: 9000 -  Early Access - Wave 1 Updates Complete![/b][/h1]

We've completed our first Wave of major updates to the game with the addition of Unexpected Events. The Rogue Planet, Fighter Assault, Cruiser Ambush, Scout Barrage and BattleCruiser Onslaught have added several new layers of play. And as the name suggest, they pop up at unexpected times and can really ruin your day, or give you a much needed boost of research if you can make it through the event.

Time Compression was added by suggestions from a group players who didn't want to skip waves, but wanted the option to play at a more intense rate in the early waves. Turning on Time Compression and playing at double speed really adds a new intensity to the game.

[b]New Features Coming Soon![/b]

[list]
[*] Leaderboards for some global top wave and competitions
[*] Stats! Kills, shots fired, energy collected, events completed, we'll start with the basics and build them up
[*] As more people join the game, they're having great ideas for more upgrades. Tractor Lock, Beam Disruption, Lunar Acceleration, Projectile Deflection
[*] The 6th set of weapons, with the inspiration being...deployment. Rack 6 will take some time, but will add all new tools to the alien destroying toolbox
[*] And the first boss event.
[/list]

Check out our new gameplay trailer showing off many of the features we've added over the last couple weeks.
[previewyoutube=00UMcXmiqTk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Earth: 9000 - Dangerous! Time Compression
notes.content:
[h1][b]Earth: 9000 - Dangerous! Time Compression[/b][/h1]

When you flip the new Time Compression toggle switch, everything moves at twice the speed.

You'll get through those waves twice as fast, but it won't be easy. Enemy shots, your shots, regen rates, you name it. Everything moves at crazy speed.

Time Compression takes the overwhelming and brings it right to the edge of too hard to defeat.

[b]Notable Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Time Compression Toggle Switch
[*] Fixed issues with events triggering at too high difficulty
[*] Adjusted so very deadly events won't trigger right away
[/list]

Time Compression brings an entire new feel to the game. Take a look at a sample of the speed here.
[previewyoutube=hTl9cjKIipk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Earth: 9000 - Unexpected Events - Rogue Planet
notes.content:
[h1][b]Earth: 9000 - Unexpected Events - Update 5 - Rogue Planet[/b][/h1]

The final update for Unexpected Events - Rogue Planet

Rogue Planet is the last Unexpected Event we're adding in the short term, last but not least. The alien menace has set a massive Rogue Planet adrift towards Earth. Although it has no offensive ability, massive chunks of debris break off of the Rogue Planet as you destroy it flying towards Earth. 

Like all the events, the deeper into the game you get, the more challenging the Rogue Planet becomes.

[b]Notable Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Rogue Planet event
[*] Fixed minor vfx bugs when using ion cannons
[*] New audio for ammo and shield pickups
[*] Blockade ship shots improved
[*] Darkest debris lightened 
[/list]


The final event for the current rotation of Unexpected Events is complete and we'll be moving on to other fun features like Leaderboards and a couple sneaky surprises.

In the meantime, check out a sample of the Rogue Planet event here. 
[previewyoutube=1Cx4iY3wObQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Earth: 9000 - Unexpected Events - Scouts and Asteroids
notes.content:
[h1][b]Earth: 9000 - Unexpected Events - Update 4 - Scouts and Asteroids[/b][/h1]

The fourth update focused on Unexpected Events - Scouts and Asteroids

Like the other unexpected events, Scout Barrage and Asteroid Storm are now in the rotation, providing two more potential events to complicate your defense of earth. Scout Barrage is simple at first but can quickly overwhelm, while Asteroid Storm pushes your defenses to the limit, with no nasty aliens to take your frustrations out on. 

Like all the events, the deeper into the game you get, the more challenging they become.

[b]Notable Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Scout Barrage
[*] Added Asteroid Storm
[*] Added more color variation in debris clouds
[*] Added better earth damage effects, to make incoming damage clear
[*] Improved ships destruction effects
[*] Fixed bugs related to upgrade display
[/list]

The final event that we're working on in the short term the, Rogue Planet is nearly finished and will be added to the rotation soon.

In the meantime, check out a sample of Asteroid Storm here. 

[previewyoutube=khVBc3VbJ8M;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.content:
You can now purchase Earth: 9000 and take part in the development of one of the best arcade experiences you've ever played.

notes.title: Earth: 9000 - Unexpected Events - Update 3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Earth: 9000 - Unexpected Events - Update 3 - Battlecruiser Onslaught[/b][/h1]

Our next update adds the new Unexpected Event - Battlecruiser Onslaught

The third Unexpected Event, the Battlecruiser Onslaught, brings two enemies that haven't been met before. First the Battlecruiser, firing it's projectiles at Earth in several different patterns to complicate your defense. While trying to destroy you with it's ordnance, it will be deploying enemy Drones, that offer no offensive capability, but protect the Battlecruiser from your weaponry.

Like the other unexpected events Battlecruiser Onslaught scales in difficulty as you progress through more difficult waves. Facing multiple Battlecruisers and their armies of drones is no easy task, good luck!

[b]Notable Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Battlecruiser Onslaught
[*] Battlecruiser enemy is not in the normal wave rotation, but we'll see...
[*] Drones may appear when you least expect them, not always just to defend the Battlecruisers
[/list]

Meteor Shower and Scout Rush are still in the works and should come on line in the next couple days.

Take a look at a sample of the Battlecruiser Onslaught
[previewyoutube=8Tp5Dldbqmg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Earth: 9000 - Unexpected Events - Update 2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Earth: 9000 - Unexpected Events - Update 2 - Cruiser Ambush[/b]
[/h1]

Our second updates is small but fierce adding the new Unexpected Event - Cruiser Ambush

As you play through the normal waves and defeat the alien invaders, there is an increasing chance of encountering one of these unexpected events. Akin to Boss battles, but not always focused on a single entity, more of a boss event. With two Unexpected Events setup and you won't know which you're going to get. Two won't be enough of course so more are on the way.

Like the Fighter Assault, Cruiser Ambush scales in difficulty as you progress through more difficult waves.

[b]Notable Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Cruiser Ambush
[*] Semi-Minor Bug Fixes
[/list]

Meteor Shower and Battleship Defense are still in the works and should come on line in the next couple days.

Take a look at a sample of the Cruiser Ambush
[previewyoutube=p8hclig_6mA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Earth: 9000 - Unexpected Events - Update 1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Earth: 9000 - Unexpected Events - Update 1 - Fighter Assault[/b]
[/h1]

One of our first updates focuses on creating special or unexpected events that occur to break up the gameplay in normal attack waves. 

As you play through the normal waves and defeat the alien invaders, there is an increasing chance of encountering one of these unexpected events. Akin to Boss battles, but not always focused on a single entity, more of a boss event.

Fighter Assault difficulty scales based on how deep into the normal waves you are. So getting a Fighter Assault while you're sub wave 10 will be pretty easy, unless your resources are low. But into the higher waves, 25 and up, you'll be facing down a couple hundred of those nasty fighters.

[b]Notable Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Fighter Assault Event
[*] Increased ammo cost of Flare Pod
[*] Flare missiles from Flare Pod using new audio, now less annoying
[*] Adjusted debris clouds to be a bit more dynamic and react properly to Atomics
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

We'll be working on more events in the coming days. Hope to have the Meteor Shower and Battleship in soon!

Take a look at a sample of the Fighter Assault
[previewyoutube=SfLCNL2yr9o;full][/previewyoutube]
